# Repeat Last Feature

![](../../assets/icons/repeat-last-feature.svg){ .tool-icon }
Make the last feature again with the same settings, on the selection or what's under the pointer (press . in the 3D view).
{ .tool-lead }

Repeat Last Feature makes the last feature again, with the same settings, on what you select now (or what's under the pointer).

## How to use it

1. Make a feature (from its panel or the command line).
2. Select the next thing to apply it to, or point at it.
3. Press <kbd>.</kbd> in the 3D view.

## Where to find it

- **Solid Design** → **Repeat Last Feature**
- Command search: press <kbd>/</kbd> in the 3D view and type its name.
